review_candidates.description: platform that connects volunteers with organisations and helps people contribute their skills to causes they care about. Our mission is to unlock global participation. You will own the commercial cycle for Mustbeus organisation subscriptions: prospecting, discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, close, onboarding into paid value, expansion and renewal. You will also build partnerships that create qualified pipeline at scale. This is a revenue role with a fixed salary and performance commission. The primary outcome is profitable, retained subscription revenue. You will convert qualified organisations from free access to paid Superhero or Professional plans when the additional features and support fit their needs, and identify larger partnership opportunities for leadership approval. Registrations and free listings matter only when they create a credible path to paid conversion, retention or a strategic channel. What you will do Own a revenue-led territory plan across agreed African countries, the UK and Europe, and selected Asian markets. Rank countries and segments by reachable demand, willingness to pay, sales cycle and revenue potential; define target accounts, decision-makers and quarterly activity. Build and manage a qualified B2B pipeline from first contact to signed, paid subscription and renewal. Engage NGOs, charities, community organisations, social enterprises, universities, foundations, CSR and ESG teams, and other organisations with recurring volunteer recruitment needs. Qualify need, budget, authority, timing and the decision process. Lead discovery and product demonstrations; connect customer needs to the right paid plan; present pricing and proposals; handle objections and procurement questions; negotiate within approved terms; and ask for the business. Own follow-up through signed agreement and first payment. Onboard new paid customers to value quickly. Support profile completion, opportunity publication, team adoption and use of paid features; identify adoption risks early and coordinate support to protect retention and renewal. Create partner channels that generate qualified sales pipeline. Develop relationships with NGO associations and federations, chambers of commerce, umbrella bodies, volunteer centres, universities, community networks, professional associations and corporate volunteering programmes. Agree partner value, referral routes and measurable commercial outcomes. Design and test responsible growth loops that create both demand and revenue: partner referrals, member cohort onboarding, local volunteer ambassadors, skills-based campaigns, webinars, community events and opportunity-sharing toolkits. Track which loops generate qualified meetings, paid conversions and retained revenue. Connect organisation sales with volunteer participation. Prioritise opportunities with a realistic route to suitable volunteers, and work with marketing and partners to help customers see outcomes from their subscription. Collect customer and lost-deal feedback. Share evidence with product, marketing and leadership on pricing, packaging, onboarding, trust, localisation and market fit; recommend changes that improve conversion, retention and revenue. Keep the CRM and forecast accurate. Report by market and channel on qualified pipeline, stage conversion, proposals, win rate, new paid customers, new MRR/ARR, cash collected, upgrades, renewals, churn and forecast accuracy. Use the numbers to prioritise effort and improve the sales process. Represent Mustbeus professionally in customer meetings, partner events and relevant sector forums; build credibility while making clear, accurate commercial claims. What strong performance looks like A consistently qualified pipeline with named decision-makers, a clear buying process, expected contract value and dated next steps. New paid organisation subscriptions and collected recurring revenue, with a growing share of suitable free organisations upgrading to Superhero or Professional plans. Partner channels that generate qualified sales opportunities and paid customers repeatedly, rather than one-off announcements or untracked signups. Improving conversion from qualified lead to meeting, proposal, paid close and renewal; reliable sales-cycle and revenue forecasts; and lower acquisition cost per retained paying organisation over time. Customers who use the platform to publish credible opportunities, engage volunteers and experience enough value to renew. Volunteer participation supports retention; it is not a substitute for revenue performance. Quarterly bookings and collected-revenue targets agreed with the manager, based on the starting pipeline, product readiness, market economics and ramp period. What you bring At least 4 years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience with evidence of personally closing paid subscriptions, software, services or comparable recurring-revenue contracts. Experience in SaaS, a digital marketplace, nonprofit technology, social impact, education, HR or an adjacent service is useful. A measurable record of revenue ownership: quota or target, pipeline created, deals closed, average contract value, sales cycle and retention or expansion. Be prepared to distinguish your own results from team results. Experience selling across cultures and building relationships in at least one priority region. Existing access to NGO networks, associations, universities, chambers or corporate responsibility teams is valuable when it can create qualified commercial opportunities. Strong discovery, product demonstration, pricing, objection handling, negotiation and closing skills. You can ask for a decision, manage a no, and protect value without pressure or overpromising. Commercial judgement and comfort with quotas, CRM systems, pipeline reviews, revenue forecasting and funnel analysis. You can explain how you would improve paid conversion and retention, not just increase leads. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional languages relevant to target markets are a strong advantage. Ability to work independently across time zones, prioritise well and collaborate with a small, distributed team. Genuine interest in volunteering, community development or widening access to meaningful participation. Compensation and sales targets The role combines a fixed salary with variable commission. The fixed salary supports sustained market development; commission rewards closed, paid and retained business. Before the role begins, Mustbeus will document the local salary band, quota and ramp period, commission rate or formula, attribution rules, payment timing, treatment of refunds and cancellations, and renewal or expansion credit. Recommended commission basis: a defined percentage of net subscription revenue actually collected from new paid accounts attributable to the representative, with a clear period of credit and accelerators for exceeding quota. Consider a smaller renewal or upgrade share where the representative owns that work. Do not pay commission for free registrations alone. Insert the actual rate, quota and payment schedule before publishing the vacancy. review_candidates.title: Officier WASH
review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Au Burkina Faso, l’IRC a démarré ses activités en avril 2019 à Djibo par une réponse d’urgence EHA/WASH, puis a progressivement étendu ses programmes à la protection, la santé, la nutrition, le relèvement économique et le développement, ainsi qu’à des initiatives de participation communautaire et redevabilité. L’IRC travaille aux côtés des populations affectées y compris les personnes déplacées internes (PDI) et les communautés hôtes pour améliorer l’accès à des services essentiels, en coordination avec les acteurs concernés. L’IRC dispose d’un bureau principal à Ouagadougou et de sites opérationnels à Ouahigouya (Yaadga) & Fada N’Gourma (Gourma). Pour renforcer son équipe programme, IRC Burkina recrute, un/e Officier Wash base/e à Ouahigouya. L’IRC promeut un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et conforme aux principes humanitaires (humanité, neutralité, impartialité, indépendance) et aux normes de sauvegarde et de redevabilité. OBJECTIFS DU POSTE/PRINCIPALE RESPONSABILITÉ Sous la supervision directe du Manager Sante Nutrition, l'Officer WASH assurera la mise en œuvre des activités WASH du projet. Il/Elle sera principalement responsable de la supervision des travaux d'infrastructures et d’ingénierie d'accès à l’eau potable et d’assainissement ainsi que la supervision de la mise en œuvre des activités de communication pour le changement de comportement social. Il/Elle fera le suivi/rapportage des données ainsi que la collaboration avec les services techniques et le partenaire AMMIE. L’objectif principal de ce poste est d’aider à gérer les aspects d’ingénierie sur les activités d’accès à l’eau potable et d’assainissement dont entre autres : réhabilitation de 6 forages dans les communes de Titao (03), Kossouka (02) et Bossou (01), la réalisation de PMH a Titao (03), Kossouka (02) et Bossou (01), réaliser tous les tests de l’eau. Également l’achat, la distribution de kits d’hygiène a 500 ménages suivi de sensibilisation dans les mêmes communes (300 a Titao, 200 a Kossouka et 100 a Bossou). RESPONSABILITÉS SPÉCIFIQUES Qualité technique Procéder aux états des lieux et diagnostics techniques des ouvrages d’eau et d’assainissement existants ; Concevoir ou réviser les plans et devis de réalisation d’ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement ; Fournir des rapports hebdomadaires sur les progrès réalisés de réalisation d’ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement ; Veiller au respect des cahiers de charge techniques et des plans par les entreprises nationales, locales pour la réalisation et réhabilitation des forage ; Maintenir des systèmes de contrôle complets sur les matériaux et les outils utilisés, y compris des notes sur la qualité des matériaux achetés ; S'assurer que tous les ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement sont conformes aux exigences nationales et locales ; Participer à l'examen et à l'évaluation du travail pour aider à améliorer l'exécution et la qualité du programme ; Demander conseil et approbation auprès du coordinateur Sante/Nutrition et les conseilleurs techniques IRC sur toute modification apportée aux conceptions approuvées d’ouvrages ; Superviser les activités de promotion de l’hygiène mis en œuvre par le partenaire AMMIE et les volontaires locaux ; Superviser la célébration des journées mondiales WASH ; Former les relais communautaires sur les bonnes pratiques d’hygiène en collaboration avec le partenaire AMMIE ; Former les AUE et les gestionnaires de PMH sur la gestion des points d’eau en collaboration avec le partenaire AMMIE ; Donner un appui au partenaire AMMIE pour le suivi des AUE et des gestionnaires de PMH ; Tenir des réunions mensuelles avec le partenaire AMMIE pour le suivi des activités mises en œuvre ; Veiller à la mise à jour régulière des bases de données de promotion de l’hygiène et de suivi des AUE ; Rédiger les rapports sur les activités de promotion à l’hygiène et de suivi des AUE ; Suivre et encadrer les Associations d’Usagers d’Eau et gestionnaires de PMH ; Faire l’analyse bactériologique de la chaine de l’eau. Suivi et supervision des travaux Superviser tous les travaux de réalisation/réhabilitation/réparation d’ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement réalisés par les entreprises nationales, locales et les maçons sur le projet ; Veiller au bon remplissage des fiches techniques des ouvrages hydrauliques ; Renseigner et mettre à jour régulièrement les bases de données des ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement ; Collecter les données GPS des ouvrages hydrauliques et d’assainissement ; Veiller au remplissage correct des cahiers de chantier par les entreprises effectuant les travaux ; Superviser les activités d’engagement/mobilisation communautaire et de communication pour le changement de comportement social ; Superviser et apporter un appui technique aux activités du partenaire AMMIE. Autres S'assurer que les femmes et les filles ont la priorité dans chaque domaine de résultats du programme afin d'améliorer la prise en compte du genre et de réduire l'écart entre les sexes ; Surveiller / évaluer systématiquement et de manière proactive la sécurité des équipes sur le terrain, signaler sans délai les problèmes ou les incidents à la direction d'IRC et assurer la liaison avec d'autres parties externes selon les besoins et de manière adéquate pour maintenir / améliorer l'environnement de sécurité ; Réaliser toute autre tâche assignée par le superviseur pour permettre et développer les programmes IRC. PRINCIPALES RELATIONS DE TRAVAIL Superviseur hiérarchique : Manager Sante Nutrition Position sous supervision directe : RAS Indirect Reporting : Managers techniques des programmes, Autres contacts : Internes : Staff IRC Externes : Les partenaires IRC Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS REQUISES/ PROFIL RECHERCHE Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur (BAC+3) au minimum en Hydraulique, Génie Civil, ou autre secteur lié à l’Eau, l’Assainissement et l’Hygiène ou dans un domaine pertinent ; Expériences, Compétences Techniques & Aptitudes Personnelles Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le suivi et le contrôle de la construction d’infrastructures d’eau et d’assainissement ; Connaissance et compréhension des standards SPHERE ; Bonnes compétences informatiques dans des programmes tels que : MS Word, Excel, Powerpoint, ainsi que logiciels techniques tels que AutoCAD, Epanet ; Compétences exceptionnelles de planification et d'organisation ; capacité à prioriser et suivre plusieurs activités et échéances simultanément, et à travailler sous pression tout en livrant les résultats attendus ; Connaissance et compréhension des concepts Ne Pas Nuire (Do No Harm) et des principes de la sensibilité aux conflits ; Responsabilité, honnêteté et grand sens de responsabilité ; Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe ; Candidatures féminines fortement encouragées. Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. review_candidates.title: NYU - CAREER FAIR FULL-TIME ENTRY LEVEL OPPORTUNITIES
review_candidates.description: Apply Job Type Full-time Description If you are a team player and ready to kick start your career in a multi-disciplined Architecture/Engineering firm, Popli Design Group (PDG) is the place for you! PDG is seeking Junior Engineers, Architectural Designers, Survey Technicians, and Construction Inspectors to add to our growing and talented teams. With offices in Buffalo, Rochester, Binghamton, Albany, and NYC/NJ, our teams will match you to the best opportunity to set you up for a successful career journey. Transportation Design, Junior Engineers In this role, you will assist in preparing design calculations, design details, specifications and cost estimates for bridge replacements, rehabilitations, and highways. Additionally, you will assist in the review of construction submittals, perform occasional field visits to collect data and evaluate existing conditions, and performs occasional field visits to resolve construction issues. Bridge Inspection, Junior Engineers In this role, you will assist the Bridge Inspection Team Leaders in conducting inspections in the field. You will actively contribute to the inspection process, helping gather data and performing necessary tasks under the guidance of experienced professionals. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting structural analyses of bridges to determine their capacity, utilizing your engineering knowledge and analytical skills. Transportation Construction Inspectors In this role, you will be responsible for inspecting the progress of basic construction operations (Earthwork, Pavement, Structural Components, Scaffolding…); Verify conformance of material with Standard Specifications by carrying out field tests (Concrete, Compaction…); Interpret documented characteristics of objects and materials used in construction; Recognize unsafe construction procedures and site conditions; Inspect erosion control and protection of environmental features and utilities; and identify measured and/or tested properties and provide appropriate notification(s) and Report(s). Civil, Junior Engineers In this role, you will assist in the areas of development of hydraulic or water distribution models, design calculations, etc. in support of comprehensive civil/site design projects under the guidance and support of licensed Engineers; Assist in the preparation of technical engineering documents, design plans, specifications, reports, and cost estimates; and assist in the preparation of comprehensive drawing packages using Civil 3D, Microstation, etc. Structural, Junior Engineers In this role, you will work on assignments that include design and analysis, modelling/drafting, preparing plans and specifications, technical report writing, cost estimating, and construction observation. Projects are typically in the municipal and academic/institutional sectors and range from new construction and large additions to structural investigations, condition assessments, capacity analysis, renovation, rehabilitation and strengthening of existing structures. Electrical, Junior Engineers In this role, you will apply your working knowledge of electrical circuit theory and design, power distribution, signs/controls to create plans using AutoCAD and/or REVIT under the close supervision of Senior Electrical staff. Additionally, you will design sections of building’s electrical systems, for both new and renovated buildings including power and lighting. Mechanical, Junior Engineers In this role, you will assist in the design of HVAC, plumbing and/or fire protection systems for building facilities. Additionally, you will perform engineering evaluations and analyses, field inspections, design drawings, technical specifications and cost estimation under direct supervision of senior engineers. About Popli Design Group (PDG) PDG is a well-established multi-disciplinary architecture and engineering firm that has been serving clients since 1982. Our extensive portfolio of successful projects has earned us a trusted reputation among our clients. Popli Design Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability or protected veteran status, and any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal law or Executive Orders. Good faith salary range is provided, and salary package will be commensurate with experience, location, and area of study. Salary Description $50,000 - $98,000
